examples.name: Default
examples.summary: An official diagram picked by `name`: the AI Gateway cost routing. It carries its own description, so it needs no `aria-label`. Switch `name` in Controls to see every registered diagram.

examples.name: Spec
examples.summary: A one-off diagram passed as `spec`. The request path of a workload. The workload is the one `lit` node, the path the request takes is `active` on its nodes and edges, and the row is `wide` so the `hit` and `miss` chips have room. Narrow the canvas and the row stacks, the branches indent under the workload, and the connectors follow.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Diagram from '@aziontech/webkit/diagram'

  const spec = {
    nodes: [
      {
        key: 'user',
        kind: 'pill',
        title: 'User',
        icon: 'pi pi-user',
        active: true
      },
      {
        key: 'routing',
        kind: 'card',
        eyebrow: 'Routing',
        title: 'Nearest data center',
        icon: 'pi pi-directions',
        active: true
      },
      {
        key: 'workload',
        kind: 'card',
        eyebrow: 'Workload',
        title: 'shop.example.com',
        icon: 'ai ai-workloads',
        status: {
          label: 'Live',
          severity: 'success'
        },
        active: true,
        lit: true
      },
      {
        key: 'cache',
        kind: 'item',
        eyebrow: 'Cache',
        title: 'Served from cache',
        icon: 'ai ai-tiered-cache',
        active: true
      },
      {
        key: 'origin',
        kind: 'item',
        eyebrow: 'Origin',
        title: 'origin.example.com',
        icon: 'pi pi-database'
      }
    ],
    layout: {
      gap: 'wide',
      row: [
        {
          node: 'user'
        },
        {
          node: 'routing'
        },
        {
          node: 'workload'
        },
        {
          branches: [
            {
              node: 'cache'
            },
            {
              node: 'origin'
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    edges: [
      {
        from: 'user',
        to: 'routing',
        active: true
      },
      {
        from: 'routing',
        to: 'workload',
        active: true
      },
      {
        from: 'workload',
        to: 'cache',
        label: 'hit',
        active: true
      },
      {
        from: 'workload',
        to: 'origin',
        label: 'miss'
      }
    ]
  }
</script>

<template>
  <Diagram
    :spec="spec"
    aria-label="A user request is routed to the nearest data center and reaches the workload, which serves it from cache on a hit and from the origin on a miss."
  />
</template>

examples.name: NodeKinds
examples.summary: One node of each kind: `app`, the quiet window of the consumer application; `pill`, the client; `card`, a platform piece with its eyebrow, icon and status; `item`, a model or provider with a mono line under its title; and `tile`, an icon-only cell whose name shows on hover.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Diagram from '@aziontech/webkit/diagram'

  const spec = {
    nodes: [
      {
        key: 'app',
        kind: 'app',
        title: 'App'
      },
      {
        key: 'user',
        kind: 'pill',
        title: 'User',
        icon: 'pi pi-user',
        active: true
      },
      {
        key: 'gateway',
        kind: 'card',
        eyebrow: 'AI Gateway',
        title: 'Route by cost',
        icon: 'ai ai-gateway',
        status: {
          label: 'On',
          severity: 'success'
        },
        active: true,
        lit: true
      },
      {
        key: 'model',
        kind: 'item',
        eyebrow: 'provider · general',
        title: 'General model',
        icon: 'pi pi-sparkles',
        status: {
          label: 'Primary',
          severity: 'info'
        },
        active: true
      },
      {
        key: 'cache',
        kind: 'tile',
        title: 'Response cache',
        icon: 'ai ai-tiered-cache'
      }
    ],
    layout: {
      gap: 'wide',
      row: [
        {
          node: 'app'
        },
        {
          node: 'user'
        },
        {
          node: 'gateway'
        },
        {
          branches: [
            {
              node: 'model'
            },
            {
              node: 'cache'
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    edges: [
      {
        from: 'user',
        to: 'gateway',
        label: 'prompt',
        active: true
      },
      {
        from: 'gateway',
        to: 'model',
        label: 'route',
        active: true
      },
      {
        from: 'gateway',
        to: 'cache',
        label: 'hit'
      }
    ]
  }
</script>

<template>
  <Diagram
    :spec="spec"
    aria-label="An app sends a prompt to the AI Gateway, which routes it to the general model or answers from the response cache."
  />
</template>
